bed.procedure: Remove stock, clean and dry. Park gantry rear and isolate drives. Remove/store 24 spoil screws and six boards; retrieve all 24 loose top-slot nuts through the panel-end gaps and thread each onto its stored screw. Remove/store 16 panel clamps and six panels. Release beam 1 and park it on its side on beam 2. Remove the two front seats and four seat bolts to their lid tray; the front lowering portal is now clear. Store beam 1 rear/lower, beam 2 front/lower, beam 3 rear/upper, beam 4 front/upper after releasing the eight beam bolts. Reverse for router mode. Map seats and re-probe after conversion.
bed.front_portal: Two removable front seats; four M8 mount screws into welded ledger sleeves. Temporary beam-on-beam parking and every handling path require explicit checks.
bed.cabinet_service: Reinstall bed and spoilboards to empty the front and left storage racks before opening controls cabinet. Fixed holders remain outside door width.
